title: Ten
notes:
First [l3346839] pressing:
• No DADC "DIDP" number on disk face
• The clear hub is stamped with "CMU" or a small "P" plus a number. (These stamps were used randomly and interchangeably and do not indicate a release sequence.)
• No SID codes.
The title "ten" is printed in its normal position on the disk face, vertically above the catalog number (compare a misprint, [r=37630449]).

Standard jewel case with a black tray and a front insert, which can fold out into a 15x15-inch (approx) "Pearl Jam" poster with credits and lyrics on the back.

Catalog Numbers: ZK 47857 on spines & disc; 47857 on front insert

Track 11 contains a hidden track (track 11.3).
Track 11.1 lasts for about 5:04 before a period of silence of about 0:15 (track 11.2).
Track 11.3 follows this at 5:19, lasting for about 3:47.
The combined total actual duration of track 11 is 9:06 (the printed duration for track 11 is 6:30).
Track 11.3 is untitled on release, but is elsewhere (e.g., on [r=1971563]) sometimes given the title "Master/Slave".

[Front Insert]
Mixed by Tim Palmer for Worlds End (America) Inc. •
Recorded at London Bridge Studios, Seattle - March/April 91
• Mixed at Ridge Farm Studios Dorking, England - June 91 •
